_comment: Copy to config/site.json for your deployment. No secrets here: API keys are entered on the site and stored privately in its database. radars lists every radar with its weekly slot (0 = Monday ... 6 = Sunday); the first one, main, is stored at the database root. A config without radars is read as that single radar. target is who runs the scan: "claude" (artifact plus scheduled task, uses artifactUrl and triggerId) or "codex" / "agent" (self-hosted server at radarUrl, see docs/self-hosted.md; optional agentCommand and scanTimeoutMinutes).
